draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.80, the 207th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 14th of 18 at TE. He went 218th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 101 receiving yards in 2021, 17th of 19 TEs in his class with stats.
